description:
Production Administrator / Estimating Assistant

Location: Bolton
Salary: £27,000 £30,000 per annum
Recruitment for: Right Hire Recruitment
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised and commercially minded Production Administrator / Estimating Assistant to join our team in Bolton.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, specifications and processes and is interested in developing a career within estimating, costing and production.

You will work closely with our Estimating and Bidding Team, providing essential administrative and technical support throughout the estimating and tender process. The role would suit an experienced administrator with an interest in manufacturing/engineering, or a recent engineering graduate looking to build a career in estimating and commercial costing.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support to the estimating and bidding team.
- Assist with the preparation and submission of quotations and tenders.
- Review customer enquiries, drawings, specifications and supporting documentation.
- Help gather information and pricing from suppliers and internal departments.
- Assist with material, labour and production cost calculations.
- Maintain accurate costing, quotation and tender records.
- Input and update information on internal systems and spreadsheets.
- Liaise with production, purchasing, engineering and other departments to obtain relevant information.
- Assist with monitoring tender deadlines and ensuring quotations are completed on time.
- Prepare reports, schedules and other documentation as required.
- Help maintain accurate product, material and pricing information.
- Support the team with general administration and coordination of production and estimating activities.

About You

We are looking for someone who is:

Highly organised and methodical.

Comfortable working with numbers and detailed information.

Confident using Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.

A good communicator who can work effectively with different departments.

Able to work accurately under pressure and meet deadlines.

Naturally curious and keen to understand how products are made and costed.

Commercially aware and interested in developing their estimating skills.

A proactive team player with a willingness to learn.

Engineering Graduates Welcome

We would particularly welcome applications from recent graduates with an engineering degree who are interested in developing a career in estimating, costing, tendering or commercial engineering.

You do not necessarily need previous estimating experience. What matters is a strong numerical and analytical approach, attention to detail and the enthusiasm to learn.

What We're Looking For

Essential:
- Strong attention to detail.
- Good numerical and analytical skills.
- Good written and verbal communication.
- Competent IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel.
- Ability to organise workload and meet deadlines.
- A genuine interest in estimating, costing and production.

Desirable:
- Previous experience in administration, manufacturing, engineering or estimating.
- An engineering or technical qualification.
- Experience working with quotations, purchase orders, bills of materials or costing.
- Knowledge of manufacturing or production processes.

What We Offer
- Salary of £27,000 £30,000, depending on experience and suitability.
- Full-time, permanent position based in Bolton.
- Opportunity to develop specialist skills in estimating and costing.
- Training and support from an experienced estimating and bidding team.
- Excellent opportunity for an engineering graduate to establish a career within a commercial/technical environment.
- A varied role with exposure to production, engineering, purchasing and commercial activities.

How to Apply

If you are organised, numerate and looking to develop a career within estimating and costing, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV to Right Hire Recruitment for consideration.

title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Working pattern: Full-time, fully office-based, with an early finish on Fridays

The Opportunity

Are you an organised administrator with a keen eye for detail and an interest in HR, training and compliance?
We re looking for a proactive HR Administrator to join a busy team, taking ownership of the day-to-day administration that keeps employee records, training activity and compliance processes running smoothly.
This is a varied position that would suit someone who enjoys keeping things organised, staying ahead of deadlines and working with people across different departments. You ll have the opportunity to develop your HR knowledge while gaining experience across employee administration, learning and development, and compliance.

What Will You Be Doing?
- Keeping employee training records, qualifications and certificates accurate and up to date.
- Tracking upcoming renewals and expiry dates, ensuring any outstanding requirements are followed up promptly.
- Organising training courses from start to finish, including bookings, schedules, attendance and communication with external providers.
- Helping managers keep track of employee training needs and identifying where actions are outstanding.
- Preparing reports and maintaining spreadsheets and databases to provide clear updates on training and compliance activity.
- Collecting and organising documentation for audits, ensuring information can be accessed when needed.
- Supporting the administration of employee and contractor documentation, ensuring records are handled securely and confidentially.
- Arranging induction sessions and coordinating mandatory training for new and existing employees.
- Assisting with apprenticeships, professional qualifications and other employee development opportunities.
- Updating relevant HR and learning systems, ensuring information is recorded correctly.
- Acting as a point of contact for general HR administration and training-related queries.
- Providing additional administrative support to the wider HR team when required.

What We re Looking For

You ll be someone who takes pride in getting the details right and enjoys bringing structure to a busy workload. You ll be comfortable communicating with different people, chasing information when needed and managing several deadlines at once.
Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in an administrative role, with exposure to HR, training or compliance being particularly beneficial.
- A CIPD level 3
- Confidence working with spreadsheets, databases and employee records.
- Excellent organisation skills and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively.
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office, and the confidence to pick up new systems.
- A professional approach to handling confidential information.
- A proactive attitude, with the confidence to follow up outstanding actions and keep processes moving.

What s on Offer?
- 27 days annual leave, including 6 days allocated to the Christmas shutdown.

- Supportive and collaborative HR team.
- Varied role with the opportunity to make a real impact.

If you re a well-organised administrator looking for a role where your attention to detail and coordination skills can make a real difference, we d love to hear from you.

title: Medical Receptionist

They will understand the importance of confidentiality, accuracy, teamwork and delivering excellent patient care. This is an opportunity to join a dedicated practice team where the reception service plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the surgery. Main duties will include: Welcoming patients and visitors and dealing with enquiries in a friendly, professional and confidential manner. Answering telephone calls, managing patient queries and directing enquiries appropriately. Booking, amending and cancelling appointments in accordance with practice procedures. Using EMIS Web confidently to access and update patient records accurately. Using Docman to manage incoming clinical correspondence and related administrative tasks. Processing patient requests, messages, prescriptions and documents in line with practice protocols. Supporting the GP-led appointment navigation process and ensuring patient requests are recorded accurately. Maintaining accurate patient information, including demographic details and relevant administrative coding. Recognising urgent or potentially concerning requests and escalating them appropriately to the clinical team. Supporting the wider administrative team with referrals, scanning, workflow management and other general practice duties. Maintaining strict patient confidentiality and complying with information governance, safeguarding and data protection requirements. The role requires flexibility, excellent organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workload while maintaining a high standard of patient service. Sullivan Way Surgery is seeking an experienced Medical Receptionist to join our busy GP practice in Wigan. The postholder will provide a professional, efficient and welcoming reception and administrative service to patients, clinicians and colleagues, supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. Key Responsibilities Act as the first point of contact for patients, dealing with telephone and face-to-face enquiries professionally and sensitively. Book and manage appointments in line with practice procedures and the GP-led appointment navigation process. Use EMIS Web and Docman confidently to access patient records, process correspondence and complete administrative tasks. Record patient requests and messages accurately and ensure these are directed to the appropriate person. Support referrals, prescription-related enquiries, scanning, workflow management and general administrative duties. Maintain accurate patient records and uphold strict confidentiality and information governance requirements. Recognise urgent concerns and escalate appropriately to the clinical team. Work effectively as part of the wider practice team, managing competing priorities and supporting colleagues when required. Comply with practice policies, safeguarding procedures, health and safety requirements and mandatory training.
